title: 2024 Panini Prizm #12 Jordan Lawlar Arizona Diamondbacks Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a rare opportunity to own a Jordan Lawlar Top Tier 2024 Panini Prizm Rookie Card from the Arizona Diamondbacks. The card features a stunning Prizm design and is numbered 12 in the set. It is perfect for collectors who are fans of Major League Baseball (MLB) and the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA). 

The card is manufactured by Panini and has no autograph. It is a sports trading card that is ideal for fans of the sport and collectors alike. The card is part of the 2024 Panini Prizm set and features a rookie design. This is a must-have for anyone who wants to complete their collection or add a valuable piece to their existing one.
